        access_token=access_token,
        direction='sent',
        min_created_at='2023-05-01',
        max_created_at='2023-05-31',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    # Check if result is a list
    if isinstance(result, list):
        all_sent_transactions.extend(result)
        if len(result) < 20:
            break
        page_index += 1
    else:
        print("Error or no more results:", result)
        break

print("Number of sent transactions in May:", len(all_sent_transactions))

    print(t)
